newsitem.title: USA: NU's Millstone reaches restart milestone.
newsitem.headline: NU's Millstone reaches restart milestone.

text.p: Northeast Utilities said on Tuesday it has successfully met its first major milestone toward the restart of the Millstone 3 nuclear power plant.
The utility said its Northeast Nuclear Energy Co subsidiary has completed the work necessary to allow the Independent Corrective Action Verification Process to begin.

This process is the Nuclear Regulactory Commission's "independent method of checking the quality and throughness of our work to assure the design and actual configuration of the plant is correct and our corrective action process is effective," Northeast Nuclear Energy explained.
The unit's chief executive, Bruce Kenyon, said it "means a great deal to us that we successfully met our first major restart milestone."

NU said readiness for the independent verification process requires the unit to finalize its internal audit plan and receive NRC approval. In addition it must, identify issues for at least 50 percent of safety and risk significant systems and associated engineering programs, receive concurrence from Nuclear Oversight, receive NRC approval for the verification contractor and provide the NRC with notification of readiness to start NRC inspection activities.
The company previously said it expects to be ready for that NRC inspection in November.
